title: Loops: repeat with purpose
summary: Use a loop to repeat instructions while changing one value each time.

scenes.narration: A loop repeats a set of instructions, changing one value each time.
scenes.heading: Loops, one step at a time.

scenes.narration: A for of loop takes each name from the list and runs the same instruction for it.
The loop prints one greeting for every name in the list.
scenes.output:
Hello, Mina!
Hello, Leo!
Hello, Asha!

scenes.narration: Use a loop when the same action needs to happen for several values.
points: A loop repeats a block of instructions
Each pass can use a different value
The loop ends when the collection is finished
